la: Agriculture: Ministerium Agriculture videt non egere auxilio propter siccitatem. Quamvis aqua humilis in Rheno et siccitate, Ministerium agriculturae in praesenti non est auxilium agricolae meditans. Res ita se habet ut superioribus annis.

de: Niedrigwasser auf dem Rhein: Bundesverkehrsministerium erwägt Aussetzung von Sonntagsfahrverbot. Wegen des Niedrigwassers vieler Flüsse denkt Steffen Bilger über erweiterte Lkw-Fahrzeiten nach. Mit der Bahn laufen Gespräche über zusätzliche Gütertransporte.
en: Low water on the Rhine: Federal Ministry of Transport is considering suspending the Sunday driving ban. Because of the low water levels in many rivers, Steffen Bilger is thinking about extending truck travel times. Discussions about additional freight transport are ongoing with the railways.

en: Low water crisis: Elbe in Magdeburg records historically lowest water level. The level of the Elbe in Magdeburg has fallen to an all-time low. Since measurements began in 1727, it has never carried so little water. The level could fall further.

de: Niedrigwasser am Rhein: Rheinland-Pfalz setzt Sonntagsfahrverbot für Lkw-Trasporte aus. Rheinland-Pfalz will Lieferengpässe wegen des extremen Niedrigwassers vermeiden und setzt auf den Transport über die Straße. Das Saarland soll Ähnliches planen.
en: Low water on the Rhine: Rhineland-Palatinate suspends Sunday driving ban for truck transport. Rhineland-Palatinate wants to avoid delivery bottlenecks due to the extremely low water and relies on transport by road. Saarland should plan something similar.
la: Humilis aqua in Rheno: Rheno-Palatinatus dominicum bannum emissionis ad onerariam suspendit. Rheno-Palatinatus vult vitare bottlenecks partus propter aquam humilem maxime et in via onerariis nititur. Saarland consilium simile.
